name: Cloverleaf
description:
Cloverleaf turns the personality and strengths assessments your team has already taken including DISC, 16 Types, Enneagram, and Motivating Values, into coaching you can use in the moment, right inside Claude.

Connect your Cloverleaf account and ask about the people you work with: "How do I work best with Dana?", "Help me prep for my 1:1 with my manager," or "How should I give this feedback?" Claude looks up colleagues in your organization, pulls their assessment-based insights, and responds with specific, behavior-based guidance instead of generic advice.

Key features:
• Search your organization and open any colleague's personality and coaching profile
• See the relationship dynamics between two to four people for a specific situation. See where you align, where you may clash, and what each person needs as an interactive card
• Start an ongoing Cloverleaf coaching plan on a topic from your conversation, in one click
• Guidance grounded in validated assessment data, not stereotypes

Everything is permission-scoped: Claude only surfaces people and insights you're already allowed to see in Cloverleaf, and no conversation content is stored.

Requires a Cloverleaf account with completed assessments. Connecting takes seconds with a secure browser sign-in (OAuth) — no API keys to manage.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cloverleaf to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cloverleaf to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.cloverleaf.me/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cloverleaf MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cloverleaf provides these MCP tools: fetch, fetchUserPersonalityDynamicsPairs, renderCoachingFocus, renderRelationshipDynamics, search, and startCoachingPlan.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cloverleaf?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cloverleaf in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Cloverleaf requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cloverleaf is developed by Cloverleaf. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
